prompt:
Goal: Create a black-and-white manga character design sheet for a sharp-eyed shonen manga boy evolving toward a Kaiji-like style, with Japanese annotation text and multiple reference drawings on one vertical page.

Canvas: Tall vertical page, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, clean white background, crisp black ink line art, professional manga production-guide layout.

Layout: Divide the page into a technical character-sheet upper half and three finished manga panels along the bottom. Use thin vertical divider lines and boxed callouts. The overall style should be monochrome manga with strong blacks, screentone, halftone dots, gray gradients, and dramatic high-contrast inking.

Main character details: Draw a teenage boy with a very angular triangular face, long pointed nose, small vertical black pupils inside inverted trapezoid eyes, stern expression, spiky jagged hair with large white and black zigzag chunks, slim tall body, high-collared fitted jacket, dark undershirt, narrow pants, and chunky shoes. His silhouette should feel like a battle shonen protagonist pushed toward a sharper gambling-manga look.

Upper section, exact visible elements: Include 10 discrete study/reference elements: 1 large front-facing head bust on the upper left-center; 1 close-up eye diagram at far left; 1 side-profile face/nose diagram below it; 1 line-thickness sample with two horizontal strokes; 1 small boxed side-profile hair/bangs study; 1 full-body front pose in the upper center-right labeled 「6頭身」; 1 full-body side pose on the far right; 1 vertical head-proportion guide with exactly 6 stacked oval head units between the two full-body figures; 1 screentone/gradation sample box with a horizontal gray gradient and 4 square tone swatches; 1 text box explaining monochrome tones.

Japanese annotation text: Add these labels in Japanese, placed as in a design reference sheet: 「逆台型の目 縦長の小さい黒丸」 beside the eye diagram; 「逆三角形の顔 とんがった鼻と顎」 beside the side-profile diagram; 「線の太さ」 above the line samples; 「外側の輪郭線：4mmペン」 beside the thicker line; 「内側の線：2mmペン」 beside the thinner line; 「髪型はギザギザで描く」 above the small hair-study box; 「6頭身」 above the front full-body pose; 「白と黒のツートーンとハーフトーンやグラデーションを使ったモノクロ漫画」 beside the tone swatches.

Bottom section, exact visible elements: Include exactly 3 separate manga panels across the bottom row. Panel 1 on the left: close three-quarter portrait of the boy looking serious in an urban street with tall buildings, smoky sky, and heavy screentone. Panel 2 in the center: dynamic action pose of the boy reaching one arm forward toward the viewer, dramatic radial speed lines exploding behind him. Panel 3 on the right: close-up side portrait of the boy looking determined against a cloudy textured background.

Visual style: Use clean vector-like manga linework but keep organic pen variation, thick outer contours and thinner inner detail lines, sharp geometric hair spikes, stark black fills, halftone shadows, grayscale gradients, and polished manga page composition. Avoid color entirely except black, white, and gray. Keep the page legible and instructional, like a professional manga drawing guide or character model sheet.

promptZh:
目标：创建一张黑白漫画角色设计表，主角为 一位向 Kaiji 风格演变的锐利眼神少年漫画男主，页面包含日文注释文本，并在同一垂直页面上展示多个参考图。

画布：高垂直页面，宽高比约为 2:3，干净的白色背景，清晰的黑色墨水线条，专业的漫画制作指南布局。

布局：将页面分为上下两部分，上半部分为技术角色设计表，下半部分为三幅完成的漫画分镜。使用细垂直分割线和框选标注。整体风格应为单色漫画，具有强烈的黑色、网点纸、半色调圆点、灰色渐变和戏剧性的高对比度墨线。

主角细节：绘制一名少年，拥有非常棱角分明的三角形脸型、长尖鼻、倒梯形眼睛内有垂直的小黑瞳孔、严肃的表情、带有大块黑白锯齿状的尖锐发型、瘦高的身材、高领修身夹克、深色内搭、窄腿裤和厚底鞋。其剪影应呈现出战斗少年漫画主角的感觉，并向更锐利的赌博漫画风格靠拢。

上半部分，具体可见元素：包含 10 个独立的学习/参考元素：左上方中心 1 个大型正面头部半身像；最左侧 1 个眼睛特写图；其下方 1 个侧面脸部/鼻子图；1 个包含两条水平笔触的线条粗细样本；1 个小型框选的侧面发型/刘海研究；右上方的 1 个全身正面姿势，标注为「6頭身」；最右侧 1 个全身侧面姿势；两个全身人物之间 1 个垂直头部比例指南，由 6 个堆叠的椭圆形头部单位组成；1 个网点/渐变样本框，包含水平灰色渐变和 4 个方形网点色块；1 个解释单色调的文本框。

日文注释文本：按设计参考表的位置添加以下日文标签：眼睛图旁标注「逆台型の目 縦長の小さい黒丸」；侧面图旁标注「逆三角形の顔 とんがった鼻と顎」；线条样本上方标注「線の太さ」；较粗线条旁标注「外側の輪郭線：4mmペン」；较细线条旁标注「内側の線：2mmペン」；发型研究框上方标注「髪型はギザギザで描く」；正面全身姿势上方标注「6頭身」；网点色块旁标注「白と黒のツートーンとハーフトーンやグラデーションを使ったモノクロ漫画」。

下半部分，具体可见元素：底部一行包含 3 幅独立的漫画分镜。左侧分镜 1：男孩严肃的四分之三特写肖像，背景为高楼林立的城市街道、烟雾缭绕的天空和厚重的网点纸。中间分镜 2：男孩动态动作姿势，一只手伸向观众，身后爆发着戏剧性的放射状速度线。右侧分镜 3：男孩坚定的侧面特写肖像，背景为多云的纹理背景。

视觉风格：使用干净的矢量风格漫画线条，但保持自然的笔触变化，粗外轮廓和细内部细节线，尖锐的几何发型，纯黑填充，半色调阴影，灰度渐变，以及精致的漫画页面构图。完全避免使用除黑、白、灰以外的颜色。保持页面清晰易读，如同专业的漫画绘画指南或角色模型表。
